title: Iran says commercial vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iranian state media claimed an Iranian commercial vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, killing one person, amid an ongoing conflicts between the United States (US) and Iran for control over the crucial energy chokepoint, CNN reported.

title: StanChart Warns Oil Is Now Built for Sharper, More Frequent Spikes
summary: Oil prices hit nearly $110 per barrel on Thursday for the first time since July, with no end in sight for the Middle East conflict. The IRGC announced on Wednesday that it had attacked and heavily damaged eight oil tankers and two U.S. Navy destroyers in the Strait of Hormuz, in retaliation after the U.S. military destroyed five IRGC-linked oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman on Tuesday night. title: Zverev defeats Shelton in four sets to win his first US Open title
summary: Germany s Alexander Zverev beats Ben Shelton of USA 6-3 7-6(2) ​5-7 6-2 to claim the men s singles trophy in New York.
